company.name: Forto
company.shortDescription: Forto is a digital freight forwarder and shipping management platform that specializes in freight forwarding.
company.description:
Forto is a leading disruptor in the European freight forwarding industry. We are revolutionizing the industry through cutting-edge technology, AI-driven automation, and integrated system solutions. 

Our strategy is focused on delivering an exceptional, seamless customer experience built on operational excellence. By executing a value-based sales approach, we elevate the impact of technology-powered processes and people, driving sustainable growth and innovation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $250,000,000, or 42.13% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,852,386 to $2,100,000,000, a 141.39x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 33 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
